senses.def: strange and silly in a funny way
senses.ex: The film is full of zany characters and silly jokes.
senses.exPt: O filme está cheio de personagens malucos e piadas bobas.

senses.def: an African wild animal like a horse with black and white stripes
senses.ex: We saw a group of zebras drinking at the river.
senses.exPt: Vimos um grupo de zebras bebendo água no rio.

senses.def: a metal or plastic fastener with two rows of teeth, used on clothes and bags
senses.ex: The zip on my jacket is broken.
senses.exPt: O zíper da minha jaqueta quebrou.

senses.def: an area that is different from others or used for a special purpose
senses.ex: The school is in a quiet residential zone.
senses.exPt: A escola fica em uma área residencial tranquila.

senses.def: one of the areas of the world that has its own time (time zone)
senses.ex: London and Lisbon are in the same time zone.
senses.exPt: Londres e Lisboa ficam no mesmo fuso horário.

senses.def: a place where wild animals are kept for people to see
senses.ex: We took the kids to the zoo on Sunday.
senses.exPt: Levamos as crianças ao zoológico no domingo.

senses.def: a camera lens that makes things look closer or further away
senses.ex: This camera has a really powerful zoom.
senses.exPt: Esta câmera tem um zoom muito potente.

senses.ex: A motorbike zoomed past us on the highway.
senses.exPt: Uma moto passou voando por nós na estrada.

senses.def: to make a picture look bigger and closer, with a camera or on a screen
senses.ex: Zoom in on the map to see the street names.
senses.exPt: Dê zoom no mapa para ver os nomes das ruas.
